cohort: 200 neonates born to mothers with confirmed COVID-19 infection at Gulbarga Institute of Medical Sciences, Kalaburagi, Karnataka, India, between April 1, 2020, and August 30, 2021.
finding: Out of 200 neonates born to COVID-19 positive mothers, 2 tested positive for COVID-19 via RT-PCR, and various clinical presentations were observed, including respiratory distress, failure to breathe at birth, fever, poor feeding, rapid heart rate, hyperbilirubinemia, abnormal chest X-ray, and oxygen requirement; however, all neonates improved and were discharged.
